file.description: CSV file, relative to the project folder. An empty cell leaves the value out.
file.title: File

mode.description: shared: one cursor per file, shared by every scenario using it. scenario: this scenario has its own cursor. random: like shared, with the rows shuffled once.

seed.description: Makes the shuffle of mode: random repeatable.
seed.title: Seed

endpoint.description: Name of a folder under endpoints/.
endpoint.title: Endpoint

name.description: Label for this step in reports, shown as scenario/name. Defaults to the endpoint name, numbered (#2, #3) when the endpoint is used more than once in the scenario.
name.title: Name

vars.description: Values for {{placeholders}}. The most specific wins: step, then scenario, then endpoint; data rows and extracted values come on top. A null value leaves the header, query parameter or JSON value it fills out of the request.
vars.title: Vars

description: A scenario file: endpoints run in order as one test.

steps.description: Endpoints to call, in order. Each is an endpoint name, or a mapping to override vars.

anyOf.description: Name of a folder under endpoints/.

steps.title: Steps

weight.description: How often this scenario is picked relative to the others.
weight.title: Weight

data.description: One row of placeholder values per iteration: a CSV path, or a mapping with file and mode. The row is shared by every step.

vars.description: Values for {{placeholders}}. The most specific wins: step, then scenario, then endpoint; data rows and extracted values come on top. A null value leaves the header, query parameter or JSON value it fills out of the request.
